findings.detail: WI-3 AC#1 says DriverMapInner should 'reuse RideMapInner's OWN_ICON/PICKUP_ICON/DROPOFF_ICON svg', but WI-5 REMOVES RideMapInner.tsx and WI-3 does not edit it. If the implementer imports the icon consts from RideMapInner (DRY reflex), WI-5's removal dangles (tsc breaks) OR retains a dead leaflet-importing module inside the driver tree (defeats removal + risks extra eager-leaflet surface). CustomerMapBackground copies CAR_ICON/PICKUP_ICON as module-level L.divIcon consts (copied not shared) — the exact pattern to mirror.
findings.suggested_fix: WI-3 AC#1: the OWN/PICKUP/DROPOFF divIcon svg markup is COPIED into DriverMapInner.tsx as module-level consts (mirroring the copied CameraController + CustomerMapBackground icons), so RideMapInner has zero remaining importers when WI-5 deletes it.

findings.rule: rules/web-testing.md#test-ordering (behaviour specified must be tested) + spec AC#4/#5 (restore + mid-ride reassignment intact)
findings.detail: WI-5 correctly RE-HOMES the DriverRidePage session hooks (useRideRestore, useLiveClear/F-04, useWakeLock, useActiveOrder, useQueuePendingCount) into DriverMapScreen — design-complete, not a gap. BUT WI-5 test_cases only assert the reconciledNote banner; nothing asserts these hooks are MOUNTED. tsc will NOT catch a silently-omitted hook call (a missing useRideRestore()/useLiveClear() still type-checks), so active-ride restore (AC#6 server-over-IDB) or F-04 reassignment could regress with a green suite. Specified-but-untested -> MEDIUM.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a WI-5 DriverMapScreen test that vi.mock's useRideRestore/useLiveClear/useWakeLock and asserts each is called on mount in the EnRoute state (useRideRestore/useLiveClear with myDriverId; useWakeLock(order != null)) — pins the re-home so a future drop goes RED.

findings.detail: WI-1 mandates informal 'ty'/'du' for ru/uk/de on new driver keys, but locales.parity.test.ts only checks key-set SYMMETRY — it cannot detect a Czech-placeholder value or a formal-register slip. Inherent to the tooling; the implementer must eyeball ru/uk/de VALUES for informal register (German 'Wähle'/imperative not 'Sie') and genuine translation.
findings.suggested_fix: During WI-1 manually verify ru/uk/de values for the new driver.* keys use informal register and are genuinely translated (not Czech placeholders); enumerate the final added-key list.

verified_not_findings.detail: LEAFLET-LAZY (highest risk) SOUND. DriverMapInner is a default-export presentational component and the ONLY driver-side importer of MapyMap/react-leaflet/leaflet (mirrors CustomerMapBackground); WI-5 loads it via lazy(() => import('./DriverMapInner')) inside Suspense, the only import site. Polyline + Markers render as MapyMap children, keeping react-leaflet in the lazy chunk. WI-5 npm-build is the dist gate. No WI risks eager leaflet.

mapCamera PROMOTION is a re-export shim, zero dangling imports. All 9 importers use relative ../shell/mapCamera resolving through the shim after WI-1 reduces it to `export * from '../../../shared/map/mapCamera'` (priceQuote precedent). tsc is the no-dangle gate. UC-015/016 imports keep working. Assumption 3 sound.

SESSION-HOOK RE-HOMING designed in (only untested — see F-2). WI-5 AC#3 re-homes useRideRestore, useLiveClear (F-04), useWakeLock, useActiveOrder, useQueuePendingCount + runTransition->reconciledNote into DriverMapScreen; owns useRideTransition, passes handlers to presentational RideSheet. Removing DriverRidePage does not drop restore (AC#6) or mid-ride reassignment.

NO-NAVIGATE-ON-ACCEPT consistent. WI-2 removes navigate('/driver/ride') on accept (spy-0-calls test); WI-5 makes /driver state-driven; router deletes the ride child. Only navigate('/driver/ride') sites are OfferTakeover.tsx + DriverHomePage.tsx (both WI-5-removed). Complete still navigates KEPT /driver/ride/complete. useRouteToast return-home preserved.

REMOVAL LIST COMPLETE. Grep of actual imports of the 5 removed modules: all importers are in WI-5 files_touched (router.tsx edits, DriverLayout.tsx edits, RideMapStrip/RideMapInner/DriverRidePage removed). Other grep hits are comment-only. tsc-no-dangle achievable.

LAYOUT/BOTTOMNAV resolved. useActiveOrderStore(s => s.order) atomic selector hides BottomNav only during active ride; Offline/Free panels are in-screen absolute overlays (not fixed BottomSheet), no collision with visible BottomNav. jsdom map-height trap called out in WI-5 AC#2.

BODYLESS POSTS + offer robustness preserved. WI-6 keeps accept/arrive/start bodyless (apiDriver omits Content-Type); complete/assign/cancel keep JSON. WI-2 preserves double-tap (isPending), stale 404/409->role=alert +2s dismiss, offline hint, useOfferSound(phase==='offer'). useOfferListener untouched.

ZUSTAND ATOMIC SELECTORS enforced (WI-5 AC#1/#4): useOwnPositionStore(s=>s.position), useActiveOrderStore(s=>s.order) — never object selectors (laneB3c loop). No-loop smoke test in WI-5. No object-selector introduced.

I18N front-loaded to WI-1 (Assumption 4). All new driver.* keys in all 6 locales in WI-1; WI-2/3/4/5 cite but never edit locale files (avoids parity race across concurrent WIs). Reused keys verified present: driver.home.status.waitingForOrder, driver.offer.staleOffer. Repo uses cs-CZ.json/en-US.json (six).

TOPOLOGY+LANES+AC sound. WI-1 -> (WI-2||WI-3||WI-4) -> WI-5 -> WI-6 acyclic; WI-2/3/4 disjoint-file parallel-safe; all lane=web. All 6 ACs map to WIs. No architecture-ban violations (mapCamera promoted to shared, no cross-feature import; single hub kept).

Both Assumptions sound. (1) Offer box session-wide in DriverLayout preserves today's behaviour (offer on /driver/history still shows Accept/Decline). (2) DriverMapScreen nests as /driver INDEX CHILD of DriverLayout (not sibling) so session mounts survive /driver/* nav; map fills Content (not fixed inset:0) is the right BottomNav-overlap fix.
